title: Gene Cernan's flashes and blinking objects in space

tellings.quote: Astronaut Gene Cernan, the last man to walk on the moon, experienced bizarre flashes, distant blinking [music] objects, and even getting hit with blinding flashes of light in the dark while he slept.

plain: Gene Cernan, the astronaut who in 1972 became the last man to walk on the moon, is said to have seen "bizarre flashes" and "distant blinking objects," and to have been hit by "blinding flashes of light in the dark while he slept." Michels tells it from a release of UFO records by the Department of War, in an episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor. If accurate, strange things were seen even on the Apollo missions.
